definitions.name: S0C.CHANGED
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND [ 1/2 ] XV -1 DROP CONCAT 'XP' BIND XV XP SUB 'XD' BIND XD XD MUL 0 GT
definitions.note: Input Vector; answers TRUE where an element differs from its predecessor, and TRUE at index 0.

definitions.name: S0C.STARTS
definitions.body: 'XF' BIND 0 XF LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 'XI' BIND XI XF 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Input Vector of truths; answers the ascending indices where it is TRUE.

definitions.name: S0C.DIVS
definitions.body: 'DV' BIND 1 DV RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DV DD DIV FLOOR DD MUL DV EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Input positive integer; answers its ascending positive divisors as a Vector.

definitions.name: S0C.DELTA
definitions.body: 'DC' BIND 1 -1 DC '(' EQ NOT DC '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT
definitions.note: Input one bracket character; answers 1 for an opening bracket and -1 for a closing one.

definitions.name: S0C.REDUCE
definitions.body: 'RS' BIND 1 6 RANGE RS [ 'IG' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: Input String of brackets; six rounds of deleting adjacent matched round and square pairs, answering what remains (the reduced form is unique).

definitions.name: S0C.WORDS
definitions.note: Input String; answers its nonempty space-separated words as a Vector of Strings.

definitions.name: S0C.JOINSP
definitions.body: [ 'WW' BIND ' ' WW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Input Vector of Strings; answers them joined by single spaces with no leading or trailing space.

solutions.runs.rle: 'V' BIND V S0C.CHANGED S0C.STARTS 'S' BIND V S GET S V LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT 'E' BIND E 1 DROP E -1 DROP SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET 1 COLLECT V -1 DROP CONCAT SUB 0 GT NOT S0C.STARTS 'S' BIND S V LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT 'E' BIND E 1 DROP E -1 DROP SUB 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.dedupe: 'V' BIND V S0C.CHANGED S0C.STARTS 'S' BIND V S GET
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND V TALLY 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 2 MUL N GT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP 0 GET
solutions.number.primes: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ S0C.DIVS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
solutions.number.binary: 'N' BIND 2 0 5 RANGE POW [ N GT NOT ] FILTER LENGTH 'L' BIND L 1 SUB 0 RANGE [ 'E' BIND '1' '0' N 2 E POW DIV FLOOR 'F' BIND F 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL F EQ NOT SELECT ] MAP JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 'N' BIND 1 200 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ 'IGN' BIND [ 'V' 'S' ] BIND V 2 DIV FLOOR V 3 MUL 1 ADD V 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL V EQ SELECT V V 1 EQ NOT SELECT S 1 ADD S V 1 EQ NOT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.number.digital_root: 'N' BIND N 1 SUB 'X' BIND X X 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
solutions.number.fib_index: 'N' BIND 1 15 RANGE 0 1 2 COLLECT [ 'IGN' BIND [ 'A' 'B' ] BIND B A B ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ N LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS 0 [ 'CC' BIND CC S0C.DELTA ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS 'CH' BIND CH LENGTH 'L' BIND 0 L RANGE [ 'K' BIND CH K TAKE JOIN S0C.REDUCE '' EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.present_mean: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P 0 [ ADD ] FOLD P LENGTH DIV
solutions.sensor.filled: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET 'F' BIND V [ 1 COLLECT ] MAP F [ 'CUR' BIND 'ACC' BIND CUR 0 GET ACC CUR 0 GET NIL? NOT SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP 'M' BIND [ FALSE ] M -1 DROP CONCAT 'PM' BIND M PM NOT AND S0C.STARTS LENGTH
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: 0 [ NIL? 'F' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 F SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND V M DIV
solutions.orders.revenue: JSON-DECODE 'R' BIND R 'orders' GET [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
solutions.orders.report: JSON-DECODE 'R' BIND R 'orders' GET [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD 2 FORMAT
solutions.orders.unpriced: JSON-DECODE 'R' BIND R 'orders' GET [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.qty_by_sku: JSON-DECODE 'R' BIND R 'orders' GET 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
solutions.orders.top_sku: JSON-DECODE 'R' BIND R 'orders' GET 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP 'SUMS' BIND SUMS SUMS 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND G KEYS SUMS 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET M EQ ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP 0 GET
solutions.orders.tag_counts: JSON-DECODE 'R' BIND R 'orders' GET [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.top_word: S0C.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP TALLY 'R' BIND R VALUES R VALUES 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET M EQ ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP 0 GET
solutions.messy.title: S0C.WORDS [ CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP S0C.JOINSP
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: S0C.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT S0C.JOINSP
